growth_signal.value: Valuation grew from about $1 billion in late 2024 to $6.4 billion in September 2026, and it acquired Portuguese AI startup Cloudsweep in July 2026 to expand its software team.

raised.value: $580M Series D (Sept 2026); earlier raised €70M in a 2024 round that made it a unicorn

entry.idea: Armies and border agencies need eyes in the sky without risking pilots, so TEKEVER builds autonomous drones and software that fly missions and gather intelligence on their own.
entry.lesson: Prove your technology works in a real conflict, and investors will keep funding you at higher and higher prices.
entry.name: TEKEVER

growth.reason: Its valuation grew roughly six-fold in under two years, backed by a $580 million round, one of the largest in European defense tech.

market.reason: Military and dual-use drone intelligence is a large, worldwide industry, made bigger by ongoing conflicts and rising defense budgets.

tech.reason: Its drone and intelligence software has been combat-tested in a real war, which is hard for new competitors to match quickly.

entry.twist: Its drones already fly real missions in Ukraine, and the same 'dual-use' technology is sold to militaries and civilian agencies alike, which has made it one of Europe's most valuable defense startups.
entry.who_pays: Governments, militaries and NATO-linked investors; it has been deployed to support Ukraine.
entry.why_now: The war in Ukraine has shown militaries need cheap, autonomous drones fast, and governments and investors are pouring money into defense technology as a result.
